text:
liz: quick thought — can we add a compact “who changed” pill on routing policy pages? quick access to actor/time/diff + export button :eyes:
omar: +1. main questions: export shape, quotas, and how we display service-account vs human names
neha: need to be careful with PII. show resolved display name for humans, but allow pseudonymized actor id in exports for certain tenants :lock:
ui-ux: idea: tiny pill next to the policy header with “who changed last” => clicking opens a small panel with 3 lines: actor, when, short diff. full export link in panel
liz: exact. we need the API to power that panel (fast read path) and a separate async export endpoint for long ranges
omar: for API shape proposal: GET /v1/audit/policy/{id}/latest -> {actor_display, actor_id, ts, short_diff_snippet, reason}
neha: and POST /v1/audit/exports with filters for tenant, actor_type, timeframe for NDJSON download. must support redaction_mode param: raw | pseudonymize | redact
ui-ux: tiny UX note — if actor is a service account show an icon and no tooltip with email by default (click to reveal after confirmation)
compliance-bot: retention policy reminder — exports for >90d require approval. track who requested export and justify reason field (100 chars max)
omar: re quotas: exports are heavy. propose per-tenant sliding quota + per-org rate limit + preview cache for the last 24h. also surface cost estimate in the panel before export :moneybag:
platform-bot: Export job queued: job-9201, estimated size 12MB, ETA ~ 90s
liz: good — we should add a guardrail: if preview cache has the same filter, offer immediate download and decrement a cheap quota, otherwise require export token and normal quota
neha: for compliance, remember to include actor_resolution_trace in the export metadata (how we mapped an actor id to a display name) — helps audits without leaking raw identifiers to UI consumers
omar: question: should actor_resolution_trace be part of every NDJSON line or a separate manifest file bundled with the export?
ui-ux: separate manifest file seems cleaner — UI can show last-modified mapping and link to it, avoids cluttering the core export stream
liz: agreed. manifest + ndjson bundle. manifest includes mapping entries, redaction mode, generator, requestor, request_ts
neha: also include a flag in the manifest if any entries were truncated for PII; this helps legal reviews
platform-bot: Note: export bundles are signed and stored for 30 days by default. presigned download link expires in 7 days
deploy-bot: FYI rolling this feature to staging now — /deploy audit-who-pill v1 -> staging
omar: small API example for the export request we can use in the consoleUI docs:

```
POST /v1/audit/exports
{
  "filters": {"policy_id": "pol_123", "since": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"},
  "redaction_mode": "pseudonymize",
  "reason": "investigating routing flapping",
  "notify": true
}
```

liz: perfect. add `preview=true` param for cache check
ui-ux: question about the panel latency — the GET latest needs to be <200ms for good UX. can we ensure a fast path (materialized latest per-policy)?
omar: yes, we can maintain a small materialized table updated on policy writes. reads hit redis for <50ms. background full audit stream still appended asynchronously
neha: encryption: manifest and bundle should include envelope encryption keys per-tenant and audit log must record key id used
ui-ux: small interaction detail — when export is created, show a non-blocking toast: "Export requested — you’ll get a link when ready" and a link to view recent exports in the console
liz: last item — rollout plan. start with internal-only rollout for 2 weeks, then opt-in for customers on Dedicated, then GA. add telemetry events: audit.ui.view, audit.export.request, audit.export.complete, audit.export.cancel
platform-bot: Telemetry events created: audit.ui.view, audit.export.request, audit.export.complete, audit.export.error
neha: make sure telemetry does not include resolved display names when redaction_mode != raw (send pseudonymized actor ids instead)
omar: agree. we'll include actor_type and actor_role in telemetry, and a pseudonymized actor_hash if redacted
ui-ux: small copy ask: export manifest link text should be "Download audit bundle (includes actor manifest)"
liz: ok folks — I'll draft a short RFC with endpoints, manifest schema, quota rules, and rollout phasing. ping me any blockers. :thumbsup:
compliance-bot: Reminder: include retention and legal hold checks in RFC
omar: tagging this for infra to review cost model and quota enforcement
neha: tagging security for KMS/HSM envelope key handling
platform-bot: Reminder: follow the export size limit config: 50GB per request (soft) and automatic chunking if >10GB
ui-ux: thanks — will mock the panel and the compact diff view tomorrow and share screenshots
liz: thanks everyone. moving to RFC draft now.
